prompts.prompt: Did I feel noticed and appreciated by you this week?
Did we express gratitude for the ordinary things we did for each other?
Did outside stress feel manageable between us this week?
Did we have enough space to say when we felt overloaded?
Did we have at least one moment of undistracted connection this week?
Did affection and closeness feel comfortable and mutual this week?
Did I receive the kind of support I needed this week?
Did we share responsibilities in a way that felt fair enough this week?
Do I feel clear about the one thing we want to prioritize together next week?
Does our plan for next week leave room for rest and connection?
